message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
Calories can vary slightly with size:

| Size (approx. weight) | Calories |
|-----------------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)         | 15 kcal |
| Medium (≈123 g)       | 22 kcal |
| Large (≈182 g)        | 33 kcal |

These values are for raw, fresh tomatoes. Cooking methods or added ingredients will change the calorie count.
